install:
set -euo pipefail
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/home-air-quality' ] || cd '/agent/repos/home-air-quality' || exit $?
sudo apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3.12-venv
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
mkdir -p "${HOME}/.npm-global"
npm install -g --prefix "${HOME}/.npm-global" @railway/cli
sudo ln -sf "${HOME}/.npm-global/bin/railway" /usr/local/bin/railway
railway --version
.venv/bin/python -c 'import flask, requests, gunicorn, pytest; print("deps-ok", flask.__version__)'
start:
set -euo pipefail
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/home-air-quality' ] || cd '/agent/repos/home-air-quality' || exit $?
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5555/health; then
  echo "dashboard already listening on :5555"
  exit 0
fi
exec .venv/bin/python server.py
